title: Connections with and without RDS Proxy
claim: Without a proxy each function holds its own database connection; RDS Proxy shares a few database connections among all of them.
alt: Two panels. Without a proxy, six Lambda functions each open a connection to one overloaded DB instance. With RDS Proxy, the six functions share two connections to the DB instance.
notes: Brief 26 compare; 2-deep.md#rds-proxy-shares-a-small-pool-of-connections-among-many-clients (after the table). Title, claim and alt from brief.json. The database sits in cell A3:B3 in both panels. A compare panel holds at most 6 nodes and 7 edges, so the six functions are one node and the counts six and two are words in edge labels (illustration, not AWS numbers; no digits). The caption has no number with a unit and no absolute word. Facts for the caption: rds-proxy-multiplexing-fewer-db-connections, lambda-vpc-db-connections-rds-proxy, rds-proxy-definition-pool-share.
